verdict.rationale: Choosing a location is a fair question for a virtual mailbox provider, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents a network of locations across multiple states or countries, nor any way to view per-location capabilities before signing up. The address-type overview (mailbox vs. TruLease vs. TruResidence) is a different choice, about address type rather than location, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a digital nomad, I can pick from a broad network of locations — multiple states and countries — and see each location's capabilities before signing up
